name: Sample test — reading and grammar
description: A tiny test showing the shape the importer accepts: sections, four question types and a norm table. Everything here can be edited after importing.
printIntro: Read the passage and answer the questions. You may not use a dictionary.

sections.title: A weekend trip
sections.content: Last weekend, Tom and his family drove to the coast. They stayed in a small hotel near the beach.

sections.title: Grammar
sections.content: Fill in the correct form of to be.

questions.prompt: True or false: they went home on Saturday.
Write a sentence of at least five words with the word "hotel".
questions.hint: 1 point for correct word use, 1 for punctuation and capitals, 1 for length.
